# Documentation Agent Guidance

Use this guidance when editing repository documentation.

## Active Docs

- `README.md`: setup, content model, and verification.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`: writing and review flow for research posts.
- `AGENTS.md`: coding-agent entrypoint.
- `ANALYTICS.md`: maintainer-only analytics setup.
- `.github/copilot-instructions.md`: current stack and development expectations.
- `.github/instructions/`: scoped file-type guidance.

## Historical Docs

Original al-folio docs live in `docs/upstream-al-folio/`. Do not treat them as active instructions and do not link them as the main path for contributors.

## Style

- Keep docs concise and operational.
- Prefer commands that work in the Docker environment.
- Avoid documenting removed features such as CVs, publications, projects, teaching pages, site search, Jupyter conversion, or RenderCV.
